name: r1t1
diagnosis: FDIR allows only one isolation and latches the first wheel to exceed residual threshold. Mild friction severity 0.2 gives ~0.45 mNm residual just above 0.3 mNm threshold and often trips first. A later more severe friction/derate then cannot be isolated, leaving the worse wheel in the active set while the healthier wheel sits isolated, reducing controllability and causing attitude-loss/saturation that no-FDIR avoids.
rationale: Enable swap to healthiest 3 wheels: if a second wheel trips while one is isolated and its residual exceeds 2.0x the recorded isolated residual, re-enable the milder wheel and isolate the worse one. This corrects the ordering race where mild trips before severe, without changing first-isolation thresholds, timing, SAFE logic, or allowing under-actuated 2-wheel operation.
why_no_regressions: First isolation, SAFE entry/resume unchanged, so nominal and single-fault paths unchanged. Swap only acts on a second trip that current policy ignores. Any 3-wheel set remains 3-axis actuated; swap only moves to demonstrably lower disturbance.
gate_reason: rejected: 20 new violations in 20 runs (20 previously clean) (evaluation stopped early after 861 runs)
